To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The impact of ICT on tourism destination supply chain can be divided into direct and indirect impact.
ICT has a significant impact on tourism destinations, and that it is possible to identify the impact of ICT on tourism destinations by analysing the literature on smart tourism.
ICT is a crucial factor for the development of smart tourism destinations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following research questions: What are the impacts of ICT on tourism destinations?
the impact of ICT on the supply chain of smart tourism destinations.
the impact of ICT on the actors involved in the smart tourism destination supply chains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the smart destination is a destination that is able to integrate ICTs into all aspects of the tourism value chain.

smart tourism is a new concept that is being developed and implemented by the tourism industry, which has the potential to transform the way that tourists interact with the tourism industry and each other.

smart tourism destinations can be defined as a tourism destination that is able to use information and communication technologies to enhance the quality of the tourist experience, and the competitiveness of the destination, and to promote sustainable development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ICT has a direct impact on tourism destinations and an indirect impact on tourism stakeholders.
the paper provides a holistic approach to smart tourism and its impact on tourism destination stakeholders.
the smart tourism is a phenomenon which is influenced by technological development and it is an opportunity for tourism destinations to become more efficient, sustainable and competitive.
The main takeaway from our work is that

ICT is a key factor in the development of smart tourism destinations, which can be used as a tool for the development of tourism resources, the development of integrated tourism products, and the improvement of communication and cooperation between destination planners and other stakeholders.
the impact of ICT on tourism destinations is multidimensional and it can be analysed in a holistic way.

ICT can help tourism destinations to become smart, and that the impact is not only limited to the destination, but also extends to other tourism stakeholders, and the local communities in which the destination is located.
